title: Characterization of stormwater at selected South Carolina Department of Transportation maintenance yard and section shed facilities in Ballentine, Conway, and North Charleston, South Carolina, 2010-2012 [North Charleston study area,  Charleston County]
citation: Journey, C.A., and Conlon, K.J., 2014, Characterization of stormwater at selected South Carolina Department of Transportation maintenance yard and section shed facilities in Ballentine, Conway, and North Charleston, South Carolina, 2010-2012: U.S. Geological Survey Scientific Investigations Report SIR-2013-5175, map scale 1:4,760.
notes:
Pages 1-29: front matter, abstract, introduction, study-area description and methods of a stormwater water-quality report (SCDOT facilities at Ballentine, Conway, North Charleston). No geologic units, borings, wells, structures or aquifer data. Physiographic-province statements and stream-gage/outfall sites (no lithology) not recorded.
Pages 80-98: organic-compound results, comparison among facilities, summary, references. No geologic content. References: only the two South Carolina-specific entries recorded; the rest (water-quality methods, statistics, EPA/SCDHEC regulations, out-of-state PAH and bacteria studies) skipped as not relevant to SC geology.
Pages 30-55: stormwater discharge, rainfall and water-quality statistics (sediment, nutrients, bacteria) for Ballentine and Conway outfalls. No geologic units, observations, structures or groundwater data.
Pages 56-79: water-quality statistics and trace-metal results for Turkey Creek (North Charleston) and Conway/Ballentine outfalls. No geologic units, observations, structures or groundwater data.
